node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f, node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 place promotional linkage in scope. A known absence of linkage returns OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than the question's stated negative answer. node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5 similarly does not return compliance outside linked promotion. Preserve the distinction between domain restriction and substantive control conditions.

The offer-level candidates combine an offer-level promotional link with an existential non-discount gift. They do not explicitly require that the same gift component bears the relevant promotional link. Mixed-purpose offers could therefore be overincluded unless the supplied classifications establish that relationship.

The SFC-authorised-fund limitation is supported by the circular's local distributor definition, but paragraph 3.11 is quoted in broader investment-product terms. The local rules should not be represented as an exhaustive implementation of paragraph 3.11 beyond the circular's scope.

The underlying Code of Conduct paragraph 3.11 and the answer to FAQ question 1 dated 30 September 2010 are identified but not supplied as external dependencies. They remain missing for verification of the complete gift standard; the circular's quotations still support the stated local restriction.

Gift status, discount status and offer attribution remain supplied judgments. The formulas do not establish those classifications. The circular says incentives may be gifts; it does not make guaranteed returns automatically gifts.
The packet does not establish operative start or end dates. The temporal runtime convention cannot itself establish the source's legal applicability at a particular assessment time.
